description.value: The study investigated regional gray- and white-matter 18F-THK5351 uptake in behavioral-variant frontotemporal dementia compared with Alzheimer’s disease and semantic dementia, including relationships with cognitive function.

spans.text: In the present study, frontal 18F-THK5351 uptake was higher in bvFTD than in other dementias only in the WM, and correlated with executive function in bvFTD.

value: 18F-THK5351 uptake in frontal WM would be higher in patients with bvFTD than in those with other dementias.

spans.text: Based on previous pathological evidence, our a priori hypothesis was that 18F-THK5351 uptake in frontal WM would be higher in patients with bvFTD than in those with other dementias.
